description: Make a draft post from a layout. Pass doc (from stills_options) or media_ids with an optional template (default: the best fit). The server draws the slides in the background: stills_get says when ready is true; post_schedule and post_submit refuse until then. With account_ids the draft is for those accounts; without, it saves as a project and the person picks accounts and a time in the app. Change the layout later with stills_change.

account_group_id.description: A posting group from account_groups_list: post to all its accounts (plus any account_ids).

account_ids.description: Accounts from accounts_list; with account_group_id, added to the group's. Leave it empty for a video or reel you made: it saves as a project and the person is told it is ready and picks the accounts. Never ask them which accounts. The iPhone's editor saves projects the same way; post_create with its post_id and accounts makes it a post

doc.description: A layout from stills_options (the doc field)

entry.description: Where it started (analytics): make, compose, mcp or web

faces.description: Where a face or subject sits in a photo, as fractions of it (media id to {x,y,w,h}). The photo is centered on it instead of the middle.

next_slot.description: Left out: an account with no time takes its next best slot (its best time from its own numbers, else its posting times or its network's usual hours), keeping its quiet days, daily cap and 45 minutes from its other posts. true: every account takes its next free slot (an error when four weeks are full). false: no time is picked, so the post has none until one is set.

recipe.description: A look from recipe_list (id or name): its grade, title font and colors are applied, with the workspace kit's colors.

scheduled_at.description: When it goes out once approved. ISO 8601: with an offset it is that moment; without one (2026-11-02T09:00) it is that clock time in the post's time zone.

schema_version.description: The stills document version the app speaks (3 now; leave out for 1). An older app gets documents in its own version, or an UPDATE_REQUIRED refusal when the layout uses something only a newer version can hold.

timezone.description: The post's own time zone (IANA, e.g. Asia/Tokyo) for a post that should go out at a clock time somewhere else; null follows the workspace's. Left out, it stays as it is (a new post follows the workspace).

title.description: Internal name. Defaults to the caption's start.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_create
title: Make a stills post
